name: Duelist's Challenge

start.dialog: Yo! You look like you can throw down! Let's have a friendly spar! No weapons, just fists! If you can land a 10-hit combo on me, I'll teach you my best moves! Deal?
start.objective: Spar with Zell and land a 10-hit combo

progress.dialog: Come on! Faster! Combo attacks! Chain them together! You can do better!
progress.objective: Continue the sparring match and build up combos

complete.dialog: WOO! That was AWESOME! You really brought it! Here - my Duel manual! All my best combos! Practice and you'll be unstoppable!

party_comments.kade: He's fast. Really fast. Good training partner.
party_comments.twist: PUNCH PUNCH PUNCH! This is great!
party_comments.grit: Hand-to-hand discipline. Refreshing change from weapons.

hidden_outcome: If you land a 20-hit combo, Zell goes all out and teaches 'Ehrgeiz' - the ultimate limit break
